checks_run.summary: Compiled scripts/check_web_smoke.py successfully with no Python syntax error.

snowflake_function_anchoring.justification: src/erdTool/projectAdapter.js now walks recognized function calls by parenthesis depth and only accepts the call when the matching closing parenthesis is the final trimmed character, preventing prefix-only and trailing-token matches from being emitted as executable defaults.

focused_regression_tests.justification: tests/test-snowflake-ddl-export.test.mjs covers executable supported defaults including CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), UUID_STRING(), TO_DATE(...), spaced current_timestamp( ), and nested DATEADD(...), plus quoted ambiguous cases for CURRENT_TIMESTAMPED(), trailing tokens, extra closing parentheses, cast suffixes, and malformed calls.

smoke_evidence.justification: artifacts/user-smoke/result.json shows app_started true, core_flow_completed true, check_exit_code 0, and an empty blocking_errors array; start_exit_code -15 is consistent with a terminated smoke server rather than a blocking user-flow error.
